inspector.level_group.tooltip: Makes the ground under each object's outline level with its foot, easing into the ground around over 3 m; trees are left out
inspector.group_hint: Drag one of them on the map to move all; with Rotate (E) the handle in their middle turns them together. Ctrl+click adds or removes an object, Esc clears the selection.
inspector.readonly: Read-only. Save a MapWorks project (File > Save map project as...) to edit this map.
inspector.attach_hint_object: Place an object on a free point to hang it there; deleting the object takes these with it.
inspector.attach_hint_row: Place an object on a free point of the row's first object to hang it there; deleting the row takes these with it.
inspector.detach.tooltip: Takes this object off, with what hangs on it
inspector.junction_note: Joins splines like a crossing: pitch and bank stay as they are, so the roads stay connected.
inspector.level.tooltip: Makes the ground under the object's outline level with its foot, easing into the ground around over 3 m, as for a house on a slope
inspector.variant_note_own: Added by {title}; it moves, turns and goes there.
inspector.variant_note_other: From {origin, select, variant {the variant {originTitle}} other {the base map}}. Moving or turning it puts a copy with a new ID into {title} in its place; deleting it takes it away there. The {origin, select, variant {variant} other {base map}} keeps it.
inspector.unresolved: Unresolved: {problem} The object stays placed as it is.
@inspector.unresolved: {problem} is a sentence of MapWorks, in English
inspector.apply_heights.tooltip: Raises or lowers the ends of this spline together with the splines joined there; their other ends keep their height.
inspector.fit_stop.tooltip: The terrain along this road returns to the original, as far as no other road changes it.
inspector.fit_start.tooltip: Lowers the ground under every spline of this road built here and shapes shoulders and slopes beside it.
inspector.delete_tile.tooltip: Takes the tile out of the map. Later tiles move up in the list and everything naming them follows. A tile stays while an entry point, timetable or something in another tile needs it.
junction.drag.leads: ; the roads are laid anew up to {meters, number, 0} m out
export.created_open_prefix: The map was created in {folder}, but it could not be opened:
@export.created_open_prefix: The text ends with a colon and a space: a reason follows
map.status.own_project_failed: The project of this map could not be made in {folder}: {reason}
@map.status.own_project_failed: {reason} is a message from the system, in English
